description: A staged daily run can be ready for candidate-table loading when every normalized object has source, dedupe, content hash, index records, and embedding work rows, even if it is not ready for active publication.
A candidate must not become an active tenant-visible component while it has open review tickets, high-risk review status, or placeholder embedding work that still requires execution.
Rows blocked by risk, review tickets, or embedding execution should be routed into an explicit review queue with blockers and recommended queue labels.
The readiness planner should write JSONL and summary evidence only; it must not connect to Postgres, apply SQL, or promote active components.
The plan should produce next actions for candidate-table load approval, real embedding execution, review resolution, and approved promotion of reviewed subsets.
Promotion readiness should accept explicit run summaries so daily production, model-ops, source-surface, and future worker fleet runs can reuse the same row-family audit without renaming outputs.
